evidence_method: Selected fields transcribed from the live Tango terminal screenshot after read-only shell commands; not a raw downloaded pstore copy.

frozen_binary.identity_basis: Original transfer hashes were verified on the phone before the interrupted invocation; this recovery did not re-read the phone binary.

symbolization.method: Unique 16 KiB-aligned load bias placing both PC and LR in the frozen ELF executable segment, checked against its retained disassembly.
symbolization.interpretation: SError was delivered after returning from this process's first aligned LSE set call, before its view check and restore call. This process had not reached its subsequent copied-code phase.
symbolization.parent_or_child_process: unknown; both execute the same na_exercise routine
symbolization.earlier_parent_phase_results: unknown until the retained probe log or process identity is recovered
symbolization.qualification: An asynchronous SError does not by itself identify a unique faulting instruction or prove the exact CPU page-table memory attribute. Load bias is inferred, not recovered from /proc maps.

probe_log_recovery.remaining_action: Locate the retained basename without assuming the recorded parent directory spelling, and preserve the relevant raw pstore excerpt.
probe_log_recovery.browser_blocker: Chrome reported another extension UI open before the next log-location command could run.

next_test_policy.reason: Userspace alarm and timeout bounds did not prevent a system-level asynchronous SError panic.
next_test_policy.cached_allocation_candidate: Separate HOST_VISIBLE|HOST_CACHED allocation with explicit flush/invalidate ownership boundaries, ordinary-memfd controls, and producer atomics disabled by default.
